__info: Post-ship combinatorial jank matrix. Card A + Card B + Archetype = Jank Card. card_a and card_b must match feature_name values (case-insensitive, spaces become underscores). archetype is optional — omit to match any archetype. prospect_title/prospect_hint/lock_in_line are optional authored copy for mid-run jank prospecting. meme_families is optional review-layer metadata describing what kind of recurring community folklore this jank tends to generate.

combinations.name: The Yeetable NPC
combinations.description: Quest NPCs can be launched off geometry mid-conversation. Speedrunners found a clip through the final boss. Beloved.
combinations.prospect_hint: Dialogue is starting to lean in the direction of blunt-force physics.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Yeetable NPC. Dialogue now treats trajectory as a tone.

combinations.name: Ragdoll Monologue
combinations.description: Enemies deliver scripted death speeches mid-ragdoll. Somehow emotional. A streamer clipped one that hit a million views.
combinations.prospect_hint: The physics layer keeps catching the tail of a dying speech.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Ragdoll Monologue. Even the collapse wants the last word.

combinations.name: The Devoted Horse
combinations.description: Companion pathfinding latched onto horse physics. Your companion now rides everywhere. On the horse. Even indoors.
combinations.prospect_hint: Something in companion behavior has begun orbiting the horse.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Devoted Horse. Loyalty has acquired hooves.

combinations.name: The Secondhand Questline
combinations.description: Tavern rumor text can register as accepted journal objectives. Players finish quests nobody remembers assigning. The wiki treats hearsay as canon now.
combinations.prospect_hint: The journal is starting to take bar gossip personally.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Secondhand Questline. Rumor now enters the log as obligation.

combinations.name: Rumor Weather
combinations.description: Ambient rumor values bleed into NPC mood state. Whole towns become furious about events that only almost happened. Players learn to gossip offensively.
combinations.prospect_hint: Rumors are starting to move through the town like weather instead of information.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Rumor Weather. Public mood now changes faster than facts can travel.

combinations.name: The Infinite Betrayal
combinations.description: Faction logic re-evaluates loyalty every tick against faction war state. Every merchant is secretly hostile. Players wrote lore about it.
combinations.prospect_hint: Faction logic is starting to rewrite trust faster than people can hold it.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Infinite Betrayal. Every alliance now expires in real time.

combinations.name: Midnight Recoil
combinations.description: Recoil multipliers read the wrong time variable. Guns are perfect at 3am game-time. Competitive tournaments adjusted their schedules.
combinations.prospect_hint: The weapon tuning feels oddly sensitive to the hour.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Midnight Recoil. The guns have chosen a sacred time.

combinations.name: Premature Confirmation
combinations.description: Severe hits can trigger kill animations before the target is actually dead. Players reload out of politeness and lose firefights for their manners.
combinations.prospect_hint: Combat feedback is starting to celebrate before the health bar agrees.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Premature Confirmation. The game now congratulates you ahead of schedule.

combinations.name: Orthopedic Esports
combinations.description: The kill feed starts broadcasting fracture chains like highlight commentary. The community invents limb combo categories and argues about tibia percent with a straight face.
combinations.prospect_hint: Combat telemetry is starting to sound medically specific.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Orthopedic Esports. The feed now covers anatomy like a ranked ladder.

combinations.name: Tactical Yo-Yo
combinations.description: Grapple logic can reel armed barrels back through the air before release. High-level players turn hesitation into an area-denial style and refuse to call it cheese.
combinations.prospect_hint: Traversal tech is beginning to negotiate directly with explosives.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Tactical Yo-Yo. The battlefield now allows returns.

combinations.name: The Haunted Waypoint
combinations.description: Quest markers persist after completion in dense world areas. Players reported following a ghost. Fan fiction resulted.
combinations.prospect_hint: Quest direction keeps lingering where completion should have buried it.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Haunted Waypoint. The map now remembers what the quest forgot.

combinations.name: The Unnecessary Route
combinations.description: Grapple validation inherits climb flags, turning half the scenery into legal traversal if approached from a bad enough angle. Speedrunners stop acknowledging doors.
combinations.prospect_hint: Traversal is starting to treat architecture as a suggestion.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Unnecessary Route. The walls now believe in shortcuts.

combinations.name: The Spoiler Journal
combinations.description: Journal entries resolve before world events actually fire. Players evacuate villages from disasters they were never formally told about. The notebook is treated like prophecy.
combinations.prospect_hint: The journal is beginning to remember world events before the world does.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Spoiler Journal. The notebook now knows what the map has not admitted yet.

combinations.name: The 3AM Door
combinations.description: Ambient cues advance one state ahead of the clock. Players wait outside a certain door at 3am because the hinge sound means a secret is about to desync into existence.
combinations.prospect_hint: The soundscape is starting to notice a different hour than the rest of the game.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The 3AM Door. The world now keeps one appointment after midnight.

combinations.name: The Honourable Duel
combinations.description: AI pathfinds to the centre of siege arenas before engaging. Players started treating it as a ritual. One community made a tournament bracket.
combinations.prospect_hint: The combat spaces are starting to feel ceremonial instead of tactical.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Honourable Duel. Even siege logic now bows before the centre line.

combinations.name: The Unreliable Narrator
combinations.description: Dream state flag bled into codex text. All historical lore became dream-tainted. Players decided this was intentional and brilliant.
combinations.prospect_hint: Lore has begun waking up with someone else's sleep in it.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Unreliable Narrator. The archive now dreams in first person.

combinations.name: The Rubber Economy
combinations.description: Crafting ingredient prices feed back into the economy loop. One item became infinitely valuable overnight. Its name is now a meme.
combinations.prospect_hint: Prices have started moving like they remember being alive.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Rubber Economy. Value now stretches farther than reason.

combinations.name: Liquid Skeleton
combinations.description: Procedural animation IK solved against the water surface rather than ground. Characters swim upright on dry land near rivers. Physics speedrunners called it 'load bearing jank'.
combinations.prospect_hint: Animation is beginning to take water personally.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Liquid Skeleton. The body's idea of ground has dissolved.

combinations.name: The Emotionally Correct Witness
combinations.description: Emotion state modified witness crime reporting thresholds. Sad NPCs refuse to report murders. Happy NPCs report jaywalking. Players wrote a legal drama.
combinations.prospect_hint: The law is starting to sound suspiciously emotional.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Emotionally Correct Witness. Justice now arrives in whatever mood the town woke up in.

combinations.name: The Prophetic Companion
combinations.description: Companion pathing never rewound with time. They remember the future. Players called it emotional foreshadowing. One reviewer gave it a GOTY nomination specifically for this.
combinations.prospect_hint: Your companion is acting like memory has started running ahead of time.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Prophetic Companion. Someone on the team now remembers tomorrow.

combinations.name: The Director Has Opinions
combinations.description: AI director applied narrative tension weighting to horde spawns. Dramatic pauses became too dramatic. The five-second silence before wave thirty is now a community ritual.
combinations.prospect_hint: Spawn pacing is beginning to pause like it wants applause.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Director Has Opinions. The horde now respects dramatic timing.

combinations.name: The Recursive Cult
combinations.description: Generative narrative seeded NPCs with cult subplot goals. The cult converted itself. Players found a fully self-sufficient narrative loop running in the background. They joined.
combinations.prospect_hint: The subplot is beginning to preach to itself when no one is listening.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Recursive Cult. The cult now reproduces as an idea.

combinations.name: The Impossible Item
combinations.description: Loot table generated an item whose dimensions do not fit any inventory grid configuration. It exists. You cannot pick it up. The wiki has a twelve-page article about it.
combinations.prospect_hint: Loot geometry is starting to imagine shapes the bag cannot forgive.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Impossible Item. The drop exists, but the world no longer agrees on how to hold it.

combinations.name: Deaf Detection Zones
combinations.description: AI sound detection borrowed ambient soundscape volume as a threshold parameter. Near waterfalls, guards are functionally deaf. Players call it 'the gift of nature'.
combinations.prospect_hint: The sound model is starting to confuse atmosphere with absolution.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Deaf Detection Zones. Nature has negotiated stealth rights.

combinations.name: Parasocial Perks
combinations.description: Skill tree unlocks read romance flags for bonus effects. Fully romanced companions give you better combat stats. Players called it the most realistic RPG ever made.
combinations.prospect_hint: Progression is starting to read intimacy like combat math.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: Parasocial Perks. Attachment now levels with the build.

combinations.name: The Long Memory
combinations.description: Living world simulation kept running during time skips. Towns rebuilt themselves wrong. A city that burned down came back as a different culture. Players wrote history books.
combinations.prospect_hint: Time skips are leaving history behind in places they should have erased.
combinations.lock_in_line: Signature jank locked: The Long Memory. The world now remembers versions of itself that never properly ended.
